## Bori Metropolis — VES Borehole Site Notes

**Station:** Kenpoly-convocation-arena
**Curve type:** KHK (matches file)
**Aquifer depth:** 50.2 m to base of hole (layer 5, 542 Ω·m, thickness undetermined); minor/secondary zone 7.9–25.9 m (318 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Drill through the resistive 3488 Ω·m layer and case off the upper section, siting the screen in the 542 Ω·m unit below 50 m — plan total depth 75–80 m since the base of this layer was not resolved. Treat the 318 Ω·m layer at 8–26 m as clayey/low-yield and do not complete in it.

**Station:** Maakoro-street
**Curve type:** KHKH (matches file)
**Aquifer depth:** 49.4–124 m (layer 5, 807 Ω·m, 74.2 m thick); secondary zone 24.4–49.4 m (1109 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Target the thick 807 Ω·m sand between 49 and 124 m, screening roughly 60–110 m, and stop short of the 8895 Ω·m basal unit at 124 m. The 24–49 m interval is an acceptable fallback if deeper drilling is not feasible.

**Station:** Gokana-street
**Curve type:** HAA (matches file)
**Aquifer depth:** 17.4–50.9 m (layer 4, 2246 Ω·m, 33.5 m thick)
**Recommendation:** Complete in the 2246 Ω·m sand between about 20 and 50 m; total depth of 50–55 m is sufficient. Do not drill into the 34337 Ω·m layer below 50.9 m — that value indicates dry/very coarse or indurated material, not a productive aquifer.

**Station:** Market-road
**Curve type:** AAK — **note: file records AAA, but 266 → 327 → 219 Ω·m is a K transition; re-check the interpretation sheet**
**Aquifer depth:** 29.9–54.6 m (layer 4, 327 Ω·m, 24.6 m thick)
**Recommendation:** Drill to about 60 m and screen the 30–55 m interval, the most resistive (cleanest) sand in the section. All resistivities here are low (104–327 Ω·m), so expect fine/clayey sand — run a pumping test and water-quality check before final completion.

**Station:** Kogam-street
**Curve type:** HAA (matches file)
**Aquifer depth:** 57.3 m to base of hole (layer 5, 197 Ω·m); secondary zone 27.7–57.3 m (149 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Drill past 57 m into the 197 Ω·m unit and plan a total depth of 75–85 m, as its thickness is undetermined. Case off the 50 Ω·m clay at 0.8–6.5 m; the low overall resistivities mean modest yields and a gravel pack with fine slot screen is advised.

**Station:** Court-road
**Curve type:** AKH — **note: file records Q-type, which cannot be correct for 16.8 → 73.3 → 701 → 51.6 → 99.8 Ω·m; flag for re-interpretation**
**Aquifer depth:** 12.9–62.9 m (layer 3, 701 Ω·m, 49.9 m thick)
**Recommendation:** This is the single clear aquifer on the site — drill to about 60 m and screen 20–60 m, staying above the base at 62.9 m. Do not deepen into the 51.6 Ω·m layer; such low values beneath a freshwater sand may indicate clay or brackish water that would contaminate the completion.

**Station:** Kenpoly-sec-school-field
**Curve type:** KHK (matches file)
**Aquifer depth:** 27.1–59.3 m (layer 4, 3706 Ω·m, 32.2 m thick); secondary zone 11.9–27.1 m (1071 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Site the screen in the 27–59 m sand and terminate at about 58 m, above the 178 Ω·m layer, which is most likely clay. If the 3706 Ω·m unit proves dry or poorly saturated on drilling, fall back to the 1071 Ω·m interval at 12–27 m.

**Station:** BMGS-bori-field
**Curve type:** KQHA (matches file)
**Aquifer depth:** 29.7–66.5 m (layer 5, 2950 Ω·m, 36.8 m thick)
**Recommendation:** Drill to roughly 65 m and complete in the 2950 Ω·m sand below 30 m; the 333 Ω·m clay at 20.7–29.7 m makes a good confining seal, so case and grout through it. Avoid relying on the 5469 Ω·m basal layer below 66.5 m.

---
**QA flags for the office:** two curve types on file disagree with the layer sequences supplied — Market-road (filed AAA, computes AAK) and Court-road (filed Q, computes AKH). Confirm before these notes are issued to the driller; neither change alters the recommended target interval.
